parsePartnerAndFeeData(uint256).details: `partnerAndFee` is a uint256 value where data is packed in a specific bit layout.      The bit layout for `partnerAndFee` is as follows:      - The most significant 160 bits (positions 255 to 96) represent the partner address.      - Bits 95 to 92 are reserved for flags indicating various fee processing conditions:          - 95th bit: `IS_TAKE_SURPLUS_MASK` - Partner takes surplus          - 94th bit: `IS_REFERRAL_MASK` - Referral takes surplus          - 93rd bit: `IS_SKIP_BLACKLIST_MASK` - Bypass token blacklist when processing fees          - 92nd bit: `IS_CAP_SURPLUS_MASK` - Cap surplus to 1% of quoted amount      - The least significant 16 bits (positions 15 to 0) encode the fee percentage.

params.partnerAndFee: Packed uint256 containing both partner address and fee data.

returns.feeData: The extracted fee data containing the fee percentage and flags.
returns.partner: The extracted partner address as a payable address.

params.amount0Delta: The amount of token0 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token0 to the pool.
params.amount1Delta: The amount of token1 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token1 to the pool.
params.data: Any data passed through by the caller via the IUniswapV3PoolActions#swap call
